purpose: Define strict exact-product, privacy-safe, pragmatic observed player-feedback evidence semantics for the neutral Taste Dossier, including directly inspected stable items, exact-product collection cards, and search/discovery result representations, while preserving temporal and neutral coverage sufficiency gates.

supersedes.limited_scope: supersedes only item-level permanent locator, transient-author identity, and stable-locator recurrence/count prerequisites from TASTE-008/TASTE-010; exact-product identity, privacy, temporal truth, TASTE-014 boundedness, TASTE-015 coverage sufficiency, GitHub ownership and buffered transport remain strict

provenance_source_locator.domain_normalization: str(value or '').strip().lower().rstrip('.'); if normalized text starts with 'www.' remove that prefix

compact_provenance.rule: Persist only safe source-level provenance, exact-product binding metadata, acquisition mode, dates/language and dossier-local join ids. Never persist raw review/post/snippet text, quotes, usernames, profile/account identity, direct author hashes or predictable author pseudonyms. Author identity is not required for evidence usability or dedupe.

feedback_item_identity.definition: one directly observed concrete player-feedback support record; stable item identity is optional quality metadata, while exact-product collection-card and search-result observations may be usable without an item locator or author identity
feedback_item_identity.stable_item_rule: when a safe neutral item URL/public_ref is actually available, preserve it and retain exact physical parent/appid checks; do not require locator chasing after usable exact-product content has already been observed
feedback_item_identity.inspected_collection_item_rule: concrete player-feedback card/item actually inspected on a safe exact-product collection; child item URL/public_ref and author identity are not required
feedback_item_identity.search_result_observation_rule: concrete player-authored/player-feedback content actually inspected in a search/discovery result representation; target-page open success is not required after the result itself exposes usable exact-product content
feedback_item_identity.duplicate_alias_rule: stable-item aliases resolving to the same physical item are rejected; obvious equivalent resurfacing of the same visible content must be deduped before serialization for all acquisition modes
feedback_item_identity.source_alias_rule: obvious URL/public_ref aliases resolving to one parent player source cannot create source diversity
feedback_item_identity.stable_internal_join_id_rule: feedback_id is a sequential dossier-local feedback-NNN support key only; when a stable physical item identity exists it remains in the validated safe item URL/public_ref

parent_item_binding.rule: stable_item records must resolve to the physical item/surface represented by source_id; locatorless observed records bind to the exact persisted source/result representation plus acquisition mode and exact_product_binding without claiming permanent child identity
parent_item_binding.reddit_rule: for stable_item parent/child locators that expose subreddit/thread identity, the child subreddit/thread must physically match the parent; locatorless observed records make no child-locator claim
parent_item_binding.steam_surface_rule: for stable_item Steam children, review/recommendation items must not be bound under an explicitly discussion parent and discussion items must not be bound under a review parent; locatorless observed modes are validated by their declared parent surface mode and exact-product binding
parent_item_binding.public_ref_surface_rule: stable_item public_ref namespaces such as steam-recommendation, steam-review, steam-discussion and reddit-comment are reconciled with the parent source type/locator
parent_item_binding.unknown_generic_surface_behavior: stable_item retains existing host/item guards; locatorless observed modes require explicit allowed acquisition mode, matching source surface mode, and strict exact-product binding
parent_item_binding.steam_exact_product_rule: for stable_item Steam children, any deterministically exposed Steam appid in child URL/public_ref must equal the exact dossier appid
parent_item_binding.steam_container_rule: when both Steam parent and stable child expose deterministically resolvable discussion/container identity, every commonly exposed container/thread component must match; host or surface-class match alone is insufficient

mention_binding.definition: mention_count is backward-compatible local bookkeeping equal to the number of distinct serialized support records bound to an observation/conflict; it is not a global review-population count, auditability score, or Dossier sufficiency threshold
mention_binding.record_rule: every bound feedback id resolves to one compact directly observed player-feedback support record whose source is player_feedback=true and is referenced by the observation/conflict; stable item locator or author identity is not required for relaxed acquisition modes
mention_binding.one_record_rule: one observed concrete player-feedback support record is anecdotal support
mention_binding.multiple_record_rule: multiple materially independent observations/sources may justify stronger qualitative recurrence; no recurrence level requires a fixed count of stable item locators

language_binding.observation_summary_rule: evidence_languages must equal the ordered distinct union of record_language_support_projection for exactly the player_feedback_ids bound to that observation
language_binding.mixed_summary_token_policy: do_not_emit_mixed_as_an_observation_summary_token; mixed is a feedback-record input language that deterministically expands to russian and non_russian support
language_binding.russian_claim_rule: russian may appear in an observation language summary only when at least one bound player-feedback record language is russian or mixed
language_binding.non_russian_claim_rule: non_russian may appear in an observation language summary only when at least one bound player-feedback record language is non_russian or mixed
language_binding.unknown_claim_rule: unknown may appear only when at least one bound player-feedback record language is unknown and must not be used as a substitute for russian or non_russian support
language_binding.conflict_statement_rule: conflicts have no separate language-summary field; any Russian/non-Russian population or language-evidence assertion in conflict.statement must be supported by the languages of that conflict's exact bound player_feedback_ids using the same projection

summary_binding.canonical_format: Evidence summary: {observation_count} validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.
summary_binding.reason: the full structured dossier already carries all observations and conflicts; the top-level summary is only a deterministic compact pointer and cannot become a second factual authority

overall_strength_binding.strong_rule: overall_strength=strong requires at least one observation with recurrence=strong
overall_strength_binding.moderate_rule: overall_strength=moderate requires at least one observation with recurrence=moderate or strong
overall_strength_binding.strong_conflict_only_rule: a strong conflict does not by itself permit overall_strength=strong

recency.dated_source_rule: when publication_date is known, freshness must be recent at age <=365 days and older at age >365 days relative to generated_at_utc date
recency.undated_source_rule: publication_date=null remains allowed; freshness then remains a worker evidence classification and current_state still requires recent
recency.known_child_date_parent_coherence_rule: when a bound feedback record has a known date older than recent_max_age_days, its parent player source must not be labeled freshness=recent or used as current_state support merely because the parent publication_date is null
recency.unknown_child_date_behavior: when the feedback record publication_date is genuinely null, preserve the existing undated source/item path without inventing a date

russian_evidence.found_and_used_rule: requires at least one bound Russian-or-mixed concrete player-feedback support record directly observed and used through stable_item, inspected_collection_item, or search_result_observation
russian_evidence.retrieval_unresolved_rule: if reliable exact-product Russian player-feedback existence is established but no concrete usable Russian/mixed player-feedback content is directly observed after all reasonably discoverable mandatory materially distinct routes are exhausted, classify existence_established_retrieval_unresolved; missing item locator alone never causes this state
russian_evidence.access_unresolved_rule: if reliable exact-product Russian player-feedback existence is established but access/tooling prevents the worker from observing any concrete usable Russian/mixed player-feedback content, classify existence_established_access_unresolved; a later target-page open failure does not apply when a prior search/discovery representation already exposed usable content

russian_discovery.site_specific_escalation: if ordinary search does not resolve the Russian attempt and a materially distinct relevant player-feedback/community route remains reasonably discoverable, try that promising route; do not enumerate sites
russian_discovery.after_existence_signal: continue toward usable concrete exact-product Russian or mixed player feedback through materially promising distinct routes; a directly inspected exact-product collection card or search-result representation may satisfy the gate without a permanent item locator or author identity

retrieval_diversification.first_failed_surface_rule: if the first reasonable route yields only aggregate/list metadata or no concrete usable player-feedback content, try a materially different public player-feedback route when reasonably discoverable and safe; missing item locator is not a failed surface if concrete usable content was already inspected
retrieval_diversification.continued_diversification_rule: continue adaptively until usable concrete feedback is observed, all required materially distinct routes are exhausted, or a directly observed runtime/tool/liveness blocker prevents observing usable content
retrieval_diversification.same_surface_diminishing_return_rule: repeated same-domain or same-surface aggregate/list/index/query variants after existence proof are materially equivalent and must not be retried ahead of reasonably discoverable distinct routes capable of exposing usable concrete player feedback

transient_author_fallback.rule: do not require or seek author identity merely to make directly observed exact-product feedback usable; stable item locator remains optional auditability metadata

transient_author_fallback.superseded_behavior: author identity is no longer required for collection-card usability or dedupe; no author/profile identity is persisted

exact_product_observation_binding.source_appid_rule: appid must equal exact dossier appid; title and release_year must be null
exact_product_observation_binding.source_title_release_rule: title must exactly equal dossier title and release_year must exactly equal resolved game_identity.release_year; appid must be null
exact_product_observation_binding.source_appid_title_release_rule: appid/title/release_year must all exactly equal the dossier/resolved identity
